units: Targ. Job XLI, 22. [Targ. Y. I Deut. I, 44 דחַדְדָן which sting; some ed. דחדרן, v. חֲדַר.]

<cite ref="Shabbat 32a:2">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>נפל תורא חַדְּדֵיה לסכינא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>חדד</he>, Ms. O. <he>חַדְּדוּ</he>) when the ox is thrown down, sharpen the knife (in critical moments man’s sins are visited, v. <cite ref="H00164"><he>חִגְּרָא</he></cite>).
Ḥull. 43ᵇ, a. fr. לחַדּוּדֵי וכ׳ to try Abbayis’ acumen.—Part. pass. מְחַדַּד ready in answering questions, well-versed, quick (v. preced.).
<cite ref="Eruvin 13b:5">Erub. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>האי דמְחַדַּדְנָא מחבירי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מחבריא</he>) the reason that I am readier than my fellow-students.
<cite ref="Yevamot 14a:4">Yeb. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>ב״ש מְחַדְּדֵי טפי</he> those of the school of Sh. were more acute.

senses.gloss: to be well studied, ready at hand.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 62b:4">Keth. 62ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>מִתְחַדְּדָן שמעתתיה</he> (Rashi: <he>מחדדן</he>) he recited his lessons (traditions) well.
